semanticNodes.canonicalMeaning: Form Preparation Instruction regarding Italicized Text
semanticNodes.structuralScopeDescription: A recurring instructional note embedded within legal guarantee forms, specifying that italicized text serves as preparatory guidance and must be removed from the final executed document.
semanticNodes.organizationalFunction: This node represents a meta-instructional element common to multiple template sections (Performance Bond and Advance Payment Security). It functions to distinguish between static boilerplate instructions and dynamic contractual obligations, ensuring the user understands which parts of the form are editable or removable before execution.
